reddit.title: Improving Colony Music Experience in Provincia
reddit.body: We've made significant improvements to how music transitions in Provincia. Instead of abrupt cuts, our new system utilizes a long equal-power crossfade to create a seamless listening experience. This means no more jarring music changes during long play sessions! Check out the details in our latest devtalk: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/soft-music-reloops?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=soft-music-reloops
